props.RED_BOOK: Original RED cloth ledger, handwritten signature shapes, distinct from black leather ledger.
props.RED_COPY: Paper COPY excerpt of the red ledger in a plain envelope. Originals are with the investigator after 34.5.
props.USB: Original USB from black ledger, preserved in an evidence sleeve at the station after 17.1.
props.USB_COPY: Separate working USB copy of the original, used with the borrowed laptop. Original stays in evidence.
props.TOKEN: USB-shaped hardware security token from the safe; NOT the metal door key.
props.RECEIPT: Dispatch receipt with seven dated boxes and a ship stamp, no readable generated text.
props.TIN: Dented fitted tin containing three sealed fictional Tê vials, no opening or use instructions.
props.VIAL: Fictional Tê device or sealed vial associated with the attackers. No real substance, dose or application technique.
props.VIAL_SAMPLE: ONE unopened sample carton filmed on its original shelf, then sealed as evidence; no recipe or usable label.
props.SCARF: One long pale-blue silk scarf, intact in the past before abduction.
props.SCARF_FRAGMENT: Short torn end of Hạ scarf, recovered by Sơn at the latch, later sealed with Mây. Not a full scarf.
props.SCARF_REMAINDER: Long remaining section of the SAME scarf, matching torn edge; given by Dũng to Mây, returned to Hạ at 52.5.

props.GLOVES: One pair of black gloves first gifted twenty-five years ago; present-day pair left in zipped cabin bag at 35.4.
props.HAIRCLIP: Hạ silver hair clip, deliberately wedged into service-hatch latch at 45.4, recovered at 48.5 and logged at 54.5.

clips.end_frame: His bare hands flat on the table, no watch used as a prop.

dialogue.text: Không ai bắt tay tôi làm. Tôi phải chịu.

dialogue.text: Ai còn sống để xác nhận chuyện này?

clips.lighting: Late-night interview room, one warm desk lamp, dim corridor outside.

scenes.title: Sổ Tiền Thành Hồ Sơ
scenes.purpose: Bằng chứng được xác minh và đời sống thị trấn bắt đầu trở lại.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Restored market sounds lead to Hạ choosing a real place for her flower stall.

clips.start_frame: Investigator reviewing the sealed originals against Thành's handover record.
clips.action: Mây delivers the remaining local witness files for the same case.
clips.end_frame: Complete evidence handover recorded, local copies retained.

dialogue.speaker: RADIO
dialogue.text: Đã khớp sổ với xưởng và chuyến tàu.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

clips.start_frame: Bảy returning an overturned chair to its regular place, Thành nearby.
clips.action: They reopen the stall together, without retelling the whole fight.
clips.end_frame: Chair upright, first clean glass on the counter.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Giờ bán cà phê lại được chưa?

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

clips.start_frame: Mây walking through the reopening fish market.
clips.action: She checks on sellers who evacuated and thanks them for keeping the routes clear.
clips.end_frame: Mây with two unnamed sellers at the repaired side gate.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn mọi người đã đưa dân ra.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

clips.start_frame: Linh at the clinic sink after filing his medical notes.
clips.action: He hangs the emptied response bag to dry and sits down at last.
clips.end_frame: Bag drying above the bench, Linh resting with a cup of water.
clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

clips.start_frame: Thành wearing replacement glasses, Mây at the case board.
clips.action: They remove the emergency duty roster and restore the normal shift plan.
clips.end_frame: Emergency roster filed away, ordinary patrol map visible.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Đêm nay trực lại như cũ hả chị?

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

clips.start_frame: Hạ at the station doorway, Mây joining her with the family-house key.
clips.action: They walk toward the harbour houses instead of the crime-scene pier.
clips.end_frame: Both walking side by side in morning light.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Về nhà trước. Chuyện khác tính sau.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning, ordinary coastal daylight and neutral interiors, no action lighting.

scenes.title: Chỗ Của Hạ
scenes.purpose: Hạ có mục tiêu đời sống riêng và bắt đầu thực hiện.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The single lily laid on a sill matches the flower in Hạ's hand outside the transport route.

clips.start_frame: Hạ and Mây at the family-house doorstep, key in Hạ's right hand.
clips.action: Hạ unlocks her father's house, Mây remains outside until invited.
clips.end_frame: Door open, Hạ inside her own threshold.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Vào đi. Nhà tao mà.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

clips.start_frame: Hạ before an old workbench with a lighthouse photograph.
clips.action: She wipes a clear space and sets her own bag down, claiming the room.
clips.end_frame: Clean patch on the workbench, her bag beside it.
clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

clips.start_frame: Empty strip beside the fish-market entrance, no finished flower stall yet.
clips.action: Hạ measures a modest place for a folding table, Mây holds the tape end.
clips.end_frame: Space marked with chalk, both facing the future stall position.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao mở ở đây. Sáng người ta đi qua đông.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

clips.start_frame: Hạ at the chalk mark, Mây holding the other end of the tape.
clips.action: Mây asks whether Hạ wants to wait until the case ends, Hạ keeps measuring.
clips.end_frame: Tape extended to the agreed edge, Hạ making her own decision.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao mở cho tao sống trước đã.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

clips.start_frame: One white lily from her father's small yard vase on the windowsill.
clips.action: Hạ trims the stem and wraps only this flower in plain paper.
clips.end_frame: Single wrapped lily in Hạ's hand, remaining vase undisturbed.
clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

clips.start_frame: Hạ and Mây reaching the public walkway, transport engine heard near the station.
clips.action: Hạ stays on the safe side of the walkway with the flower rather than running into the road.
clips.end_frame: Hạ visible from the transport lane, Mây beside her.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao đứng đây. Ảnh sẽ thấy.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning, soft house daylight, bright public walkway.

scenes.title: Qua Ô Cửa Xe
scenes.purpose: Chia tay bằng một ánh nhìn, không diễn lại nhiều lần.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Vehicle engine recedes, replaced by the empty cabin's wind after it has passed.

clips.start_frame: Inside the prisoner transport, Sơn in olive jacket after a documented clothing change.
clips.action: Thành sits opposite with the transfer file, signals the public walkway ahead.
clips.end_frame: Sơn turning toward the side window, Thành giving him space.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Bên phải. Cạnh hàng cây.

clips.time_ellipsis: later before transport, Sơn has changed back into his stored olive jacket
clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning, natural vehicle-window light, coastal sun outside.

clips.start_frame: View from Sơn's window, Hạ at the public walkway with one wrapped lily.
clips.action: She lifts the flower only to chest height as the vehicle approaches.
clips.end_frame: Hạ holding one lily against her chest, eyes on the moving window.
clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning, natural vehicle-window light, coastal sun outside.

clips.start_frame: Sơn beside the mesh window, closed watch chain secured inside his jacket.
clips.action: He acknowledges Hạ with one small nod, keeping his cuffed hands low.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's nod finished, eyes still following her.
clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning, natural vehicle-window light, coastal sun outside.

clips.start_frame: Transport already beyond Hạ, both women on the walkway.
clips.action: Hạ lowers the flower and turns toward her chosen stall site.
clips.end_frame: Both women walking back toward the market, vehicle continuing away.
clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning, natural vehicle-window light, coastal sun outside.

clips.start_frame: Sơn facing forward again as the town thins outside.
clips.action: Thành opens the destination transfer file, the journey continues without another farewell.
clips.end_frame: Sơn seated quietly, file open in Thành's lap.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi rời đi bằng tên mình.

clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning, natural vehicle-window light, coastal sun outside.

clips.start_frame: Transport approaching the crossroad where the coach once stopped.

clips.end_frame: Empty crossroad, transport sound receding inland.
clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning, natural vehicle-window light, coastal sun outside.

scenes.title: Căn Nhà Còn Mở Cửa
scenes.purpose: Thị trấn giữ ký ức nhưng tiếp tục sống, Hạ bắt tay làm sạp.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Fresh wood sanding becomes a finished flower-counter surface years later.

clips.start_frame: Cabin door open, Bảy carrying a repair box, Mây with the final rental inventory.
clips.action: They check the now-empty room together rather than preserving it as a shrine.
clips.end_frame: Empty bed, cleared table, repair box by the threshold.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Mai tui sửa lại cửa. Còn cho thuê.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon, warm working porch light, pine shadows moving naturally.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon, warm working porch light, pine shadows moving naturally.

clips.action: She asks to use the porch to prepare flower buckets while the stall site is finished.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Cho con mượn chỗ làm cái sạp nhé.

clips.end_frame: Stable table, one empty bucket upright on it.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Nhà này gió. Làm chân bàn chắc vào.

dialogue.text: Để dưới quầy. Nhắc mình đã đi qua.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon, warm working porch light, pine shadows moving naturally.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon, warm working porch light, pine shadows moving naturally.
